title: Choose the homepage world for RayMindset
question: The roll assigned The Unfinished Line (route B, Infinite Atlas, carrying route C's unfinished structure). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Unfinished Line
options.lineage: Transit network diagrams and rail tickets; brief route B (Infinite Atlas) fused with C (Unfinished Monument)
options.thesis: Ray's mind drawn as a transit network: the seven rooms are stations, and the line to The Unknown is drawn but not yet built.
materials: ticket card stock with notched edges
options.viewport: Night ground; a 3D wire model of the network floats in depth with cursor parallax; a notched ticket reads WELCOME TO RAY'S MIND. with Enter the mind / Skip intro.
options.risk: Can read as a metro-map gimmick if the stations are not filled with real chapters; depends on Ray's verified timeline to earn its stops.

raised.raise: Each line owns its chapter: Discipline floods the whole field in the line's red, a full-colour chapter rather than an accent.
The route never wraps, it scales; a ticket stub pinned bottom-left always says which station you are at.
One line rules the layout: sections hang off the route's path instead of a box grid.
Each verified milestone lays one segment of track; unconfirmed stops are drawn as planned track, never as built.
Reduced motion and no-WebGL hold one complete still of the whole map, never a half-drawn one.
Moving between rooms changes the station sign in the persistent nav, so scroll position is always visible.

options.label: The Mind Museum
options.lineage: Brief route A: cabinet of curiosities, gallery rooms
options.thesis: Floating artefacts in dark rooms: the gloves, the suitcase, the notebook, each a door to a chapter.
options.viewport: One spot-lit artefact turning slowly with a museum label carrying the hero line.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of 'Ray's mind'; needs modelled objects (gloves, suitcase) that cost time and risk looking like stock 3D.

options.label: Rebel Menu Collage
options.thesis: Every chapter a red full-screen splash slammed on a wall.
options.viewport: Scarlet field, a silhouette lunging across a starburst.
options.case: Fits the boxing chapter only; fails partners and investors on credibility.
options.risk: Reads as a game, not a person.
options.kept: Full-colour chapter commitment, given to Discipline.

options.label: Village Coffeehouse Identity
options.thesis: Woodcut marks stamped over torn kraft.
options.viewport: A woodcut sun over torn paper.
options.case: Nostalgic and earthy; Ray's world is not this.
options.kept: The header changes its mark per section: visible scroll position.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Sixteen step keys under a chase light.
options.viewport: A row of keys and a tempo readout.
options.case: An instrument costume; no tie to Ray's story.
options.kept: The line never wraps, it scales; 'where now is' is always shown.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Barcode columns strobing black and white.
options.case: Generic tech; the brief bans tech particles, and strobing fails accessibility.
options.kept: One complete still under reduced motion.

options.label: Curved Crease Shell
options.thesis: One arc lifts a flat sheet into a rigid shell.
options.viewport: A cream disc rising into a saddle.
options.case: Elegant metaphor for one line making structure, but strangers would not read it as a person.
options.risk: Abstract to the point of anonymity.
options.kept: One line rules the layout instead of a box grid.

options.label: Coiled Earth Tower
options.thesis: A tower rising course by course.
options.viewport: Clay ropes circling upward in late light.
options.case: Close to route C, but terracotta earthiness is not Ray's world.
options.kept: Each verified milestone lays one segment; unconfirmed ones stay planned.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A founder personal site: dark hero with portrait and name, about, ventures grid, journal, contact.
canonCard.viewport: Name and one line over a large portrait, two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every founder site; also needs a portrait that does not exist yet.
